_comment: Curated map of well-known single-SNP traits reliably covered by consumer genotyping chips. Each trait lists the rsID(s) to look up, plus how to read the genotype. 'effect' maps a normalized genotype to a plain meaning. Genotypes are matched strand-aware by the app; keys here are on the + strand as ClinVar/dbSNP report them. This is a knowledge base, not a diagnosis — every entry is a well-established common-trait association, not clinical guidance.

traits.summary: A variant upstream of the LCT (lactase) gene determines whether lactase production continues into adulthood (lactase persistence).

rs4988235.AA: Likely lactase-persistent — typically able to digest lactose as an adult.
rs4988235.AG: Likely lactase-persistent — one copy is usually enough for lactose digestion.
rs4988235.GG: Likely lactase non-persistent — more likely to be lactose intolerant as an adult.

traits.summary: CYP1A2 sets how fast caffeine is cleared. The A allele is the 'fast metabolizer' form.
ALDH2 breaks down acetaldehyde from alcohol. The A allele reduces enzyme function, causing the facial-flush reaction.

rs671.GG: Normal ALDH2 — no typical alcohol-flush reaction.
rs671.AG: Reduced ALDH2 — often flushes and is more sensitive to alcohol.
rs671.AA: Strongly reduced ALDH2 — strong flush reaction, low alcohol tolerance.

traits.summary: TAS2R38 affects the ability to taste certain bitter compounds (PTC/PROP) found in brassica vegetables.

rs713598.GG: Taster — perceives these bitter compounds strongly.
rs713598.CC: Non-taster — perceives little of this bitterness.

traits.summary: ABCC11 determines wet vs dry earwax type (and correlates with axillary body-odor type).
ACTN3 (the 'sprinter gene') affects fast-twitch muscle fibre function. The C allele produces functional protein.

rs1815739.CC: Two functional copies — associated with power/sprint performance.
rs1815739.TT: No functional ACTN3 — more common in endurance profiles.
